notes: An evil and adulterous generation: the supplied An is given to the noun under rule 58 rather than to the adjacent adjective.
seeketh after keeps the preverb particle inside the verb's unit under rule 106, the object being accusative and so carrying no case for an English preposition to realize.
no sign splits into οὐ → no and σημεῖον → sign: σημεῖον is not itself a negative, so rules 41 and 59 neither empty the negator nor join the pair, the ASV having written two English words.
εἰ μή → but is noncompositional headed on εἰ, exactly as rule 39 names it.
